entries.title: claude agents dashboard + /goal command
entries.paragraph: New claude agents opens a dashboard listing every active session in one place. New /goal sets a completion condition and displays elapsed time, turn count, and token spend live during the run.
entries.whyItMatters: Visibility across parallel work without tab-hopping, plus a hard stop so runaway agents stop burning tokens.

example.code: /goal Review changed files and stop after one PR comment per finding

entries.title: Opus 4.7 is now the Fast-mode default
entries.paragraph: Hitting /fast now uses Opus 4.7 instead of 4.6. Same latency profile, smarter model. Override with CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE=1 if you need the old one.
entries.whyItMatters: Free quality bump on every Fast-mode invocation. No code change.

entries.title: Plugin dependency enforcement
entries.paragraph: You can no longer disable a plugin that other plugins depend on. The dependency graph is read and the toggle is blocked with a clear error. The marketplace UI also now shows projected context cost per plugin before install.
entries.whyItMatters: Stops the silent broken-plugin cascade and surfaces context cost before you pay it.

entries.title: Hooks can emit desktop-notification terminal sequences
entries.paragraph: Hooks now support a terminalSequence output for desktop notifications without taking control of the terminal. Also: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS for environments without SSH.
entries.whyItMatters: Background sessions can ping you when something needs attention instead of silently waiting.

entries.title: Breaking: v2 session API removed
entries.paragraph: The unstable v2 session helpers (unstable_v2_createSession and friends) are gone. Use query() instead. Also: MCP servers now connect in the background — sessions start immediately with status: "pending" while slow servers warm up.
entries.whyItMatters: If any code imports unstable_v2_* the build breaks today. query() covers the same surface and the docs are now stable.

entries.title: @anthropic-ai/sdk moved to peerDependencies
entries.paragraph: @anthropic-ai/sdk and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk are now peer deps instead of direct deps. Auto-installed by npm / bun / pnpm so runtime is unchanged.
entries.whyItMatters: Smaller bundles, no duplicate copies in node_modules, fewer version conflicts. Old lockfiles may emit a peer warning — rerun install to fix.

entries.title: Work with Codex from anywhere
entries.paragraph: Connect a Mac running Codex to the ChatGPT mobile app. From your phone you can see project files, change configuration, and trigger runs on the desktop.
entries.whyItMatters: Replaces the ssh-home-to-check-the-long-run workflow. No tunneling, no VPN, no port-forward.

entries.title: Codex for Chrome — extension launches
entries.paragraph: Browser extension that runs Codex across multiple tabs in parallel without taking control of your mouse. Per-site allow-list controls which tabs it can touch.
entries.whyItMatters: Useful for batch web tasks (filling many admin forms, scraping multiple dashboards) that run while you keep working in other tabs.

entries.title: Codex CLI 0.130.0 — visible plugin hooks + Bedrock auth
entries.paragraph: Plugin details now show every hook the plugin bundles before you install. Bedrock auth uses your AWS console-login credentials directly. App-server gained pagination for large thread histories.
entries.whyItMatters: Audit plugins before installing them instead of trusting blindly. AWS users get a much shorter setup path.

entries.title: Codex CLI 0.129.0 — Vim modal editing in TUI
entries.paragraph: The TUI composer supports modal Vim editing. The resume/fork picker got redesigned. Plugin management can share state across workspaces.
entries.whyItMatters: If you live in vim, the Codex TUI no longer fights your muscle memory.

entries.title: Breaking: DALL·E 2 / DALL·E 3 removed
entries.paragraph: The dall-e-2 and dall-e-3 models are no longer served. Migrate to gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1, or gpt-image-1-mini. The Realtime API Beta is also deprecated with a migration guide.
entries.whyItMatters: Any code that still passes model: "dall-e-3" to images.generate returns 404 today. One-line model id change, but you have to ship it.

entries.title: Realtime 2 — voice, Translate, Whisper
entries.paragraph: New realtime voice model with configurable reasoning depth. Plus dedicated APIs for streaming speech-to-speech translation and streaming Whisper transcription.
entries.whyItMatters: If you build voice features, this is the new default. Separate Translate and Whisper endpoints let you keep pipelines simple — no more rolling your own.

entries.title: OpenAI Agents SDK now in TypeScript
entries.paragraph: The Agents SDK ships a TypeScript version with sandboxed agent execution and an open-source harness built in.
entries.whyItMatters: Real shortcut for Node services that have been wiring tool-calls by hand. Sandboxed exec means an agent can run code without owning your machine.

suggestions.title: Audit every dall-e-* call site before it 404s
suggestions.paragraph: OpenAI removed the DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3 models on May 12. Any service still calling images.generate({ model: "dall-e-2" }) or "dall-e-3" returns 404 right now.
suggestions.whyItMatters: One-line fix per call site, but you have to find them all. The model usually fails silently — paths exercised rarely won't surface the break until a real user hits them.

example.code:
# find every call site in your codebase
rg 'model:\s*["'\''"](dall-e-[23])["'\''"]' --type ts

# then change model to gpt-image-2 (drop-in replacement)

suggestions.title: Grep for unstable_v2_ before the next Agent SDK bump
suggestions.paragraph: Claude Agent SDK v0.3.142 removed the v2 session API. If any tool, worker, or test imports unstable_v2_createSession (or its siblings), the next dependency bump kills the build.
suggestions.whyItMatters: Dependabot tends to propose Agent SDK bumps quietly. Catching this now avoids a red-CI fire-drill later.

example.code:
rg 'unstable_v2_' --type ts
# migrate hits to:
#   import { query } from "@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk"
#   const r = await query({ model, prompt, cwd })

suggestions.tiesTo: Claude Agent SDK · v0.3.142 — v2 session API removed

suggestions.title: Wrap long unattended Claude sessions with /goal
suggestions.paragraph: Any nightly automation, batch PR review, or CI-triggered Claude pass benefits from a hard done-condition. /goal sets one and shows a live overlay of elapsed time, turns, and token spend.
suggestions.whyItMatters: Catch runaway loops in seconds instead of finding them in next month's invoice.

example.code: /goal Stop after producing a single PR comment per finding

suggestions.title: Drop the Opus 4.6 Fast-mode override env var
suggestions.paragraph: Claude Code v2.1.142 made Opus 4.7 the Fast-mode default. Anyone on the team still pinning Opus 4.6 via CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE=1 should drop the pin — there's no quality reason to keep it.
suggestions.whyItMatters: Zero code change. Smarter model on every /fast call.

example.code:
# audit dotfiles + CI env
rg 'CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE'
# remove the export and reload

suggestions.title: Try Codex for Chrome on batch admin tasks
suggestions.paragraph: Codex for Chrome runs across multiple tabs in parallel without grabbing your mouse. Permissions are scoped per site, so you can let it touch one admin panel without giving it the whole browser.
suggestions.whyItMatters: Replaces hand-grinding through repetitive web tasks (form fills, status checks, dashboard exports). Time saver for ops work.
